# Ascent Vision

> Ascent Vision LLC is a Florida marketing company (formed October 2026) that builds websites, Google and AI-search visibility (SEO and GEO) and lead-generation systems for service businesses, and tracks every lead back to where it came from. Founders: Clayton Camera and Grayson Sorrentino.

Ascent Vision publishes no testimonials, prices or result figures it cannot show from its own records, and it does not guarantee rankings or leads.

## Pages

- [Ascent Vision: Websites, SEO and AI-Search Marketing](https://ascentvision.org/): Ascent Vision builds websites, Google and AI-search visibility and lead systems for service businesses, and tracks every lead back to where it came from.
- [About Ascent Vision and Its Founders](https://ascentvision.org/about/): Ascent Vision LLC is a Florida marketing company founded in October 2026 by Clayton Camera and Grayson Sorrentino.
- [FAQ: SEO, GEO and Working With Us | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/faq/): Straight answers on what Ascent Vision does, how GEO differs from SEO, how results are tracked and who owns the work.
- [Privacy Notice | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/privacy/): What Ascent Vision collects through its forms, why, who sees it and how to have it deleted.
- [Services: Websites, SEO, GEO and Leads | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/): Websites, Google and AI-answer visibility, and lead generation, each built around one action and measured by where every lead came from.
- [Work With Us: Start a Marketing Project | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/work-with-us/): Tell Ascent Vision about your business and what it needs: a website, Google and AI-search visibility, or lead generation and tracking.
